2608.05573.title: SkillTV-Bench: Benchmarking How Well Judges Perform on Skill-Augmented Agentic Execution
2608.05573.paper_summary: LLM agents increasingly execute long-horizon tasks through tool use and environment interaction, shifting evaluation from final-response scoring to verification of complete executions. For skill-augmented agents, verification additionally requires the procedural knowledge encoded in task-time skills, because this knowledge indicates what evidence to inspect and which failures are task-critical. However, existing judge benchmarks often expose final responses or static trajectories, and rarely combine task-time skills with directly inspectable artifacts and environments. We therefore introduce SkillTV-Bench, a 681-case benchmark of real agent trajectories from 50 tasks across eleven domains, designed to evaluate skill-aware trajectory verification for both LLM-as-a-Judge and Agent-as-a-Judge methods. Additionally, we propose SkillTV-Evolve, which externalizes verification knowledge as a reusable JudgeSkill that guides an agent judge to plan targeted inspections and issue evidence-grounded verdicts. On a disjoint development pool, an automated evolution loop further refines the JudgeSkill using misjudged cases. On SkillTV-Bench, the refined skill increases the same agent judge's accuracy by 14.8 percentage points. In offline rollout-pool selection, it increases selected-trajectory success from 22.9% with one rollout to 45.5% with ten rollouts. The code and data are available at https://github.com/HanZhi306/SkillTV-Bench
2608.05573.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理越來越多地通過工具使用和環境互動來執行長期任務，將評估從最終回應評分轉向完整執行的驗證。對於技能增強的代理，驗證還需要在任務時間技能中編碼的程序知識，因為這些知識指示了應檢查哪些證據以及哪些失敗是任務關鍵的。然而，現有的評判基準通常暴露最終回應或靜態軌跡，並且很少將任務時間技能與可直接檢查的工件和環境結合起來。因此，我們引入了 SkillTV-Bench，這是一個包含 681 個案例的基準，涵蓋來自 50 個任務的真實代理軌跡，跨越十一個領域，旨在評估對於 LLM-as-a-Judge 和 Agent-as-a-Judge 方法的技能感知軌跡驗證。此外，我們提出了 SkillTV-Evolve，將驗證知識外部化為可重用的 JudgeSkill，指導代理評判者計劃有針對性的檢查並發出基於證據的裁決。在不重疊的開發池上，自動進化循環進一步通過錯誤判斷的案例來精煉 JudgeSkill。在 SkillTV-Bench 上，精煉後的技能使同一代理評判者的準確率提高了 14.8 個百分點。在離線滾動池選擇中，它將選定軌跡的成功率從一次滾動的 22.9% 提高到十次滾動的 45.5%。代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/HanZhi306/SkillTV-Bench 獲得。
